_meta.source: VA GI Bill Comparison Tool workbook (ComparisonToolData.xlsx, Comparison_Tool_Data_Full, Quick Facts date 2026-08-27) for the universe, approval, flags, tuition, books and location; the VA per-institution API (api.va.gov/v1/gi/institutions) for the housing figure, Yellow Ribbon participation and aliases
_meta.filter: The July 2026 universe carried forward (approved US PUBLIC, PRIVATE and FOR PROFIT institutions, one main campus per IPEDS unit-id, K-12 removed), minus 0 that lost VA approval, plus 0 institutions approved since with at least one GI Bill student
_meta.mhaBasis: mha = the VA's dod_bah: the DoD E-5 with dependents BAH the VA pays students who first used Post-9/11 benefits on or after Jan 1, 2018, CY2026 table (AY 2026-27). This is the figure the VA Comparison Tool shows as Housing allowance. The workbook's bah column is the legacy pre-2018 rate, $126 above dod_bah stateside and equal to it in PR and the territories; 477 extension sites without their own API record take bah less that offset and carry mhaDerived: true. null with mhaNote where the VA carries no figure (9 schools). Planning estimate; confirm in the VA GI Bill Comparison Tool.
_meta.yellowRibbonBasis: VA participation flag (yr), what the Comparison Tool page shows as Yellow Ribbon Program: Yes. Before this build the badge was keyed off Yellow Ribbon dollars paid last fiscal year.
_meta.aliases: Short names for search. aliases = the VA alias list where the VA carries one plus a hand list for the largest universities; initials = an initialism generated from the name, ranked below a real alias. gibill = GI Bill students last year, the tie-breaker so a flagship outranks a branch. 5318 schools carry at least one short name.
_meta.uiNote: Searchable list of VA-approved US schools. Figures are estimates that change annually. Verify your school in the VA GI Bill Comparison Tool.
